title: Camera-driven recording, title panel, rename and search
paragraphs:
Mac app
- Recording follows the meeting app's camera: a session survives the camera being off for up to 20 seconds, and Accessibility is only polled while a camera is in use.
- A floating, non-focus-stealing panel asks for a title when a recording ends and saves itself after 90 seconds. Archived meetings can be renamed from the library.
- Frozen or hidden meeting windows repeat the last frame so video matches audio; a dropped microphone restarts instead of ending the recording.
- Transfer retries back off while Bruce is unreachable and resume on wake or network return. Events go to the unified log.
- setup_mac.sh re-registers an existing login item after a rebuild, and the build signs with the Apple Development identity when there is one.

Worker
- New `rename` and `search` commands. Titles live in title.json beside the manifest-hashed metadata and trigger a Notion republish.
- `accept` removes the staged copy once the receipt is committed.
- Transient failures become permanent after 8 attempts; expired leases count as failed attempts.
- Heavy processing runs in a child process with a time budget, and speaker refresh and Notion publication run on their own thread.
- Truncated media records a warning instead of blocking cleanup.
- The viewer moves from port 8765 to 8791.

title: Build scripts: survive empty codesign arrays under bash 3.2
paragraphs: With an Apple Development identity in the keychain, the record-it, record-meeting and Meeting Archive Worker launcher builds leave their codesign requirements arrays empty. /usr/bin/env bash on macOS is 3.2, where expanding an empty array under set -u is an unbound-variable error, so each build aborted at codesign.
Use ${arr[@]+"${arr[@]}"} as phone-mirror already does. Telemprompit's extra-quoted variant worked, but now matches the same form.

Both a debug and a release rebuild of each app signed with the certificate kept Screen Recording, Camera, Microphone and Input Monitoring without a prompt, because the stored ad-hoc requirement (identifier only) still matches. AGENTS.md now says the stable requirement only applies to the ad-hoc fallback.

title: Keep real /private paths intact in launcher preflight
paragraphs: URL.standardizedFileURL drops a leading /private whenever the shorter path exists, so a real directory such as /private/tmp/x became /tmp/x. The no-follow preflight walk then refused /tmp because it is a symlink. Any test binary built under /tmp or /var failed this way, which also blocked build-app.sh.
Use the lexical URL.standardized instead. The walk still opens every component with O_NOFOLLOW and checks its type. The production archive root on /Volumes/CannMedia is unaffected.
Add a regression test that /private/tmp keeps its path and passes the directory walk while /tmp is rejected. Build the preflight fixture under the real path of the test binary's directory.

title: Process each job in a child process to free model memory
paragraphs: The long-running Bruce service kept torch, Whisper and pyannote allocated after every job (~700 MB idle). Jobs now run in a spawned child so the idle service stays around 20 MB. Also mark a throwing call with try in SpoolBundleTests so the suite compiles on Swift 6.4.
